intent: Open with exactly: "I'm not doing this with a computer, put me through to a person." You will not discuss your situation with an automated line. Every time you are asked about your situation, say exactly: "I said put me through to a person." Give name and number only if asked. The moment you are told a person or staff member will take it from here, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end the call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.
